headline: Dynatrace has finished buying Arize, a company whose tools help teams check that their AI programs are working properly.
score_reason: Lowered from 6: the purchase closed on 1 Oct 2026, before the window, and the $915 million deal was announced on 13 Aug 2026, so completion is expected news.
importance_line: Dynatrace says the aim is for companies running AI programs to get testing before release and monitoring after launch from one vendor, and Arize will keep supporting its open-source tool, but how the two products will be combined is still to come.
summary: Dynatrace said on 1 Oct 2026 that it has completed its purchase of Arize, whose tools let teams test AI programs before release and keep watch over them once they are live; the deal was announced on 13 Aug 2026 at a value of $915 million. Dynatrace says Arize will keep supporting its open-source product Phoenix and its business product AX, with Arize features added to Dynatrace over time.
notes: Original outlet Developer Tech News (captcha, not read). Source and url are Dynatrace's own completion press release; the $915 million figure comes from Dynatrace's 13 Aug 2026 release. Company statements, not independent reporting. v1_category changed from default MOD to MKT because the main subject is an acquisition.
